about: Package BAL26 (merge of BAL24): the Map reference (40 games a deck) and the 10 simulated reference-ladder decks (12 games a deck each) against every PRO / BPRO / WPRO deck of Maps 0-20, as tools/opt/pro_ease.js plays them; merged from pro-ease-bal26-map.json, pro-ease-bal26-ladder-a.json, pro-ease-bal26-ladder-b.json by tools/bal26/pro_ease_merge_2026_11_07.js. win = the reference's win rate.
